_schema: DSv4-Flash progressive wall-time ledger. One baseline + one row per op integrated, in order. Wall time = end-to-end model forward with DETERMINISTIC_DUMMY weights, MoE-anti-collapse input (plugin/validate/moe_balanced_input.py), steady-state median (DO NOT time step 0). Each op is integrated ONLY after a standalone cosine fingerprint gate (cos >= 0.9999 vs torch/GPU reference) passes. 'speedup_vs_baseline' and per-op 'delta_ms' are filled after the E2E re-run. PENDING = not yet measured.

timing_recipe.weights: DETERMINISTIC_DUMMY=1 (skip real load; bit-identical CPU/GPU dummy)
timing_recipe.bind: OMP_NUM_THREADS=64 OMP_PROC_BIND=close OMP_PLACES=cores, one rank per socket/NUMA domain; bind ONCE at init (never per-forward)
timing_recipe.measure: INTEL_CPU_DSV4_TIMEIT=1 end-to-end; median of steps 1..N (step 0 = cold, excluded); >=3 runs, report median

integration_gate.metric: per-layer + per-op cosine fingerprint vs reference (torch eager / GPU oracle) on the SAME dummy weights
integration_gate.threshold: cos >= 0.9999 (first layer/op below localizes the break); set-match for top-k ops
integration_gate.rule: integrate one op at a time; re-run E2E only after the op's fingerprint gate passes

ledger.label: baseline (unoptimized plugin, all ops torch/donor as-is)
ledger.note: Establishes the reference wall time. Run first, before any op integration.

ledger.label: op#1 DSA indexer logits (fused GEMM+epilogue, best-of tiled/bmm)
ledger.standalone: DONE (BW-bound; off machine-peak 5.9/7.7/13.2x @64/32/16; vs torch 5.34/5.84/6.68x; surfaced-as-plateaued)

ledger.label: op#2 DSA indexer top-k (512)
ledger.standalone: DONE (custom nth_element; wins 16/32/64 + M1; N=8 fallback decision open)

ledger.label: op#7 Lane-A ceiling verification (MLA proj / MoE experts / attn / lm_head)
